text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for Bamboo Memory for a while, but she hasn't shown up for training.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: TRAINER! I'M SO SORRY! I didn't mean to be late!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I got completely caught up watching this red-hot show… But I'll make up for it! A hundred laps should be appropriate! Plus a hundred-page apology letter!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: As part of the disciplinary committee, I'm supposed to be watching for latecomers! And despite that, I… I…
choice_data_list: It's enough that you realize your mistake.
It's enough that you realize your mistake.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh… You're so understanding! That makes me even more embarrassed! You've left me with no choice…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'll do a thousand laps around the track! And write a thousand-page apology letter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory seems truly remorseful, so I tell her not to beat herself up too much.
